title.narrative: Electoral and Political Processes in Syria (EPP)

description.narrative: (Syria): The goal of the Syria Elections and Political Processes (S-EPP) is to build citizen engagement in responsive democratic processes to contribute to a political solution to the conflict in Syria. To that end, S-EPP supports progress toward a political solution to the conflict in Syria while ensuring processes are inclusive of women, youth, ethnic and religious minorities, and other marginalized groups. S-EPP promotes stability and the reintegration within communities of Syrians recently liberated from ISIS by improving inclusive citizen-state relationships at the local level, including through local elections and improved processes for addressing the needs of citizens, including returnees. Finally, S-EPP enhances social cohesion and the participation of citizens, returnees, civil society, and other stakeholders in electoral, political, and transitional processes and in their communities. Using FY 2024 funds, USAID will support civil society organizations to increase the availability of services for Al Hol returnees and to advocate with local authorities on behalf of community needs. USAID will also support reintegration by encouraging local governance reforms to support returnees' needs and strengthening social cohesion thereby reducing stigmatization of returnees..
